column1: At low magnification, non-papillary urothelial carcinoma may show solid or irregular infiltrative tumor architecture and unevenly distributed cellular tumor nests.
At low magnification, papillary urothelial carcinoma may show branching papillary fronds with stromal cores and cellular urothelial layers covering papillary projections.
At high magnification, non-papillary urothelial carcinoma may show cohesive nests of atypical urothelial cells and variation in tumor nuclear size.
At high magnification, papillary urothelial carcinoma may show atypical urothelium lining fibrovascular cores and variation in urothelial nuclear size.
